visual_action: A short video clip shows Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein laughing together at an indoor event. The video then cuts to two still photos. The first shows Donald Trump shaking hands with Sean 'Diddy' Combs. The second shows Sean 'Diddy' Combs, Donald Trump, and Melania Trump sitting and posing together.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown in archival footage with Jeffrey Epstein and in still photos with Sean 'Diddy' Combs and Melania Trump.

cast.name: Jeffrey Epstein

on_screen_text.text: I had the dates wrong...all this time.

spoken_summary: A female voiceover says, "I had the dates wrong...all this time" over the clip of Trump and Epstein. The voice then says, "Diddy, come on out!" as a transition to showing photos of Trump with Sean 'Diddy' Combs.
audio_music: A dramatic instrumental track plays throughout. A loud, jarring buzzer or alarm sound effect is used for the transition from the Epstein clip to the Diddy photos, creating a startling effect.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single clip followed by a quick succession of two still photos, with a hard cut between the video and the photos to create a reveal.
central_claim: Donald Trump has a history of associating with controversial figures accused of sexual crimes, including Jeffrey Epstein and Sean 'Diddy' Combs.
intended_effect: To make the viewer question Donald Trump's judgment and character by highlighting his past associations with Jeffrey Epstein and Sean 'Diddy' Combs.
